findings.claim: connectedPads() only guards against navigator.getGamepads being absent. Per the Gamepad spec the method throws a SecurityError when the gamepad permissions policy blocks it, e.g. the game embedded in a cross-origin iframe without allow="gamepad". The throw is uncaught, so keyboard and touch players lose all input and the race never ticks.
findings.evidence: Code: `if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.getGamepads !== 'function') return [];` then `for (const p of navigator.getGamepads()) ...` with no try/catch. Trace: stub navigator.getGamepads to `() => { throw new DOMException('blocked', 'SecurityError'); }`, call createInput({keyTarget: new EventTarget(), pointerTarget: new EventTarget()}).read(): it throws, although AC4 says an unavailable Gamepad API must leave keyboard input working. In src/game.ts frame(), `if (confirmMenu()) return;` runs input.confirmPressed() -> readGamepads() -> connectedPads() on every animation frame before the `mode !== 'race'` check and before tick(r, input.read()). Every frame throws, so the countdown never advances and the menu loop is broken for everyone in that context. Before this diff, keyboard and touch worked there.
findings.suggestedFix: In connectedPads(), wrap the navigator.getGamepads() call in try/catch and return [] on a throw, so 'blocked' behaves like 'no pads', the same as the existing typeof guard: `let list: readonly (Gamepad | null)[]; try { list = navigator.getGamepads(); } catch { return []; }`. Add a test in tests/input/gamepad.test.ts with a throwing stub that checks keyboard read() still works.

findings.claim: readGamepads() adds the analogue steer of every connected standard pad. If one physical controller is exposed twice (a driver or Steam Input virtual copy, both with mapping 'standard'), the stick effect doubles: half tilt saturates to full lock and gentle pushes turn twice as hard. Only the boolean buttons are safe to OR across pads.
findings.evidence: Code: `for (const p of pads) { const dpad = ...; steer += dpad + stickSteer(p.axes[0] ?? 0); ... } return { steer: clampSteer(steer), ... }`. Input: navigator.getGamepads() returns [padA, padB], both connected, mapping 'standard', axes[0] = 0.6. One pad gives stickSteer(0.6) = (0.6-0.15)/0.85 = 0.529 and read().steer 0.529. Two identical pads give 0.529 + 0.529 = 1.059, clamped to 1, so read().steer is 1. Any stick position at or past 0.575 already reads full lock. A test with `pads = [pad({x: 0.6}), pad({x: 0.6})]` and `input.read().steer` shows 1 where one pad gives 0.529.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not add analogue contributions across pads. Per pad compute `const s = clampSteer(dpad + stickSteer(p.axes[0] ?? 0)); if (Math.abs(s) > Math.abs(steer)) steer = s;` and keep gas, brake and confirm OR-ed. A single pad behaves exactly as now, so the existing AC tests are unaffected.

checked.how: Read in full. Traced start screen -> A -> RACE, results -> A -> NEXT RACE, and A mid-race. visibleMenu() is null mid-race: Grep of 'ui-screen' shows only overlay() in dom.ts creates .ui-screen, so the HUD, countdown and touch layers are never matched. No bug.

checked.target: Edge detection (createConfirmEdge) and the fresh-press rule, AC6
checked.how: wasDown is updated on every frame() call because confirmMenu() runs before the mode check. A held across start -> race -> results never re-fires. The only stale case is A held while the loop is stopped (pause) and then QUIT TO MENU, which is contrived, so I did not report it.

checked.target: `!input.confirmPressed() || paused` ordering and the paused guard
checked.how: setPaused(true) calls stopLoop(), so frame() never runs while paused. startRace and showMenu both clear paused, and ui.reset()/ui.resume() hide the pause screen. The guard is belt-and-braces and the pause screen cannot be activated. Matches the spec and plan-audit scope note.

checked.target: Focus handling: document.activeElement vs the visible menu
checked.how: overlay().show() focuses RACE / NEXT RACE. A focused element outside the menu, or a non-button, falls back to .ui-button--primary (RACE on start, NEXT RACE on results; RETRY is not primary). A hidden focused button cannot be targeted because of menu.contains(focused). The PAUSE HUD button cannot be clicked mid-race because visibleMenu() is null.

checked.target: Re-entrancy: startRace() called from inside the rAF callback
checked.how: startRace() runs the same code as a DOM click. startLoop() is a no-op because rafId !== 0. frame() returns right after, and startRace already drew once. accumulator and lastFrame are handled as on the click path (lastFrame is updated every frame, including on the menu).

Checked the arithmetic: no -0 (0-0+0), NaN is turned to 0 by stickSteer, and left+right keys cancel before the pad is added. The sim's steerToInt8 (world.ts:92) quantises live and replay steer identically, so analogue steer stays deterministic.

Hand-computed: 0.15 and -0.15 give 0 (strict >), 0.2 gives 0.0588, 0.6 gives 0.529 > 0.4's 0.294, -0.6 is the exact negation, ±1 gives ±1. Button indices 0, 6, 7, 14, 15 match the standard mapping. Missing buttons and axes fall back via ?. and ?? 0.

The diff touches no src/sim file. Pad input only enters through CarInput.steer, which steerToInt8 quantises. gates.md shows G2 bot laps +0.0% and G3 five replays reproduced. No wall clock, Date or Math.random added.

checked.target: Listeners, timers, rAF, DOM nodes added by the diff
checked.how: The diff adds none. confirmPressed() is polled, not evented, and createInput.destroy() needs nothing extra. The existing blur/resize/visibilitychange listeners are unchanged.

checked.target: Other implementers and callers of the Input interface
checked.how: Grep for createInput|confirmPressed|readGamepads: the only consumers are game.ts and tests; the driver does not implement Input. Adding the required confirmPressed() breaks no caller, and the typecheck gate passes.

checked.target: results.css: is NEXT RACE visible when A can fire?
checked.how: Read results.css animations: only the stripes, rows and roundel animate (visibility hidden->visible in ui-results-deal). .ui-results__actions has no animation, so A never activates an invisible button.

checked.target: Mid-race A vs the car (AC7) and the post-finish path
checked.how: readGamepads().confirm is never read by Input.read(). tick() forces NO_INPUT once racers[0].finishTick is set, so held pad inputs cannot move the car on the results screen.

checked.target: Touch/keyboard paths with the pad present
checked.how: keyboard.ts and touch.ts are unchanged. Pad steer is added to the key/touch steer, then clamped. A held arrow plus an opposite stick gives a value in -1..1, as AC4 expects. Pad gas and brake are OR-ed.

Read both. Each test stubs and removes navigator.getGamepads. games are not parked with showMenu() as pause-review.test.ts does, but frames is reset in beforeEach and no Esc or resize is dispatched, so nothing leaks between tests. Tests are new files only, with no .skip, .only or ts-ignore.

Changed files are src/game.ts, src/input/gamepad.ts, src/input/index.ts and two new tests, all allowed. There are no colour or pixel literals and no env sniffing: typeof navigator is feature detection, not sniffing. Relative imports use .ts. src/input imports no sim code.
